abstract.t: This specification defines mechanisms to improve cryptographic agility in OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 by enabling discovery and negotiation of JSON Web Token (JWT) signing algorithms between a client and an authorization server. It registers the authorization_server_jwt_signing_algorithms_supported metadata value in the IANA "OAuth Authorization Server Metadata" registry established by RFC 8414, and registers the jwt_signing_algorithm parameter in the IANA "OAuth Parameters" registry established by RFC 6749 for use in both authorization requests and jwks_uri retrieval requests.
